notes.text: The dataset contains twelve independent synthetic pumps, not six hydraulically coupled pairs. Seven are training, two are validation and three form the test split. Public equipment metadata supports coverage planning. Release disclosure: during phase-1 mutation testing, a disabled gate allowed PUMP-10 feature rows into one pytest process before approval. The implementer reports no values were printed, saved, compared or analysed; no model or parameter selection followed. The fixed causal B1 was subsequently exported under an exact manifest gate: 23 rows, schema valid, 42 prefix checks passed. This is not a pristine untouched blind evaluation. Test quality is unknown without organizer scoring. No labels or organizer predictions were used. Source: docs/tasks/007-coordinator-review.md; results/release/execution_manifest.json; assets.csv; diagrams/README.md.

notes.text:
Exact scores: causal 76.01253946; original 78.01253946. Score is not accuracy. The two-point decrease follows a later first match for PUMP-09-E04: 2026-02-11 06:28 UTC versus original 2026-02-09 12:46, a 41 h 42 min delay. The type remains wrong and evidence points at vibration instead of the drifting current sensor. Diagnostic rules did not improve. The first 24-hour reference may contain degradation. Checks are recorded software evidence, not a universal proof for all inputs. Source: CAUSAL_B1_FINDINGS.md; results/causal_b1/comparison.csv and verification.json. Subsequent B2 experiments are not claimed by this slide.
New evidence, reviewed 6 November 2026: Task002 r2 train control C0 detected18/26, correctly typed8/26, false+excess6 over49 asset-days. C1:21/26,7/26,21; C2–C5:21/26,6/26,20. All five fail registered gates, so C0 remains selected. None of the rejected candidates was scored on validation. 59 tests passed;1547 new prefix comparisons and810 supplemental original train-cut comparisons had no failures. R1 is archived invalid due None/NaN representation instability; corrected r2 disclosed. Source: results/causal_b2/CAUSAL_B2_FINDINGS.md and selection.json, commit0b3fb89. This does not establish that all cadence-aware approaches fail.
Final bounded research: five B2 candidates plus S2/S3 sparse follow-ups and R1/R2 regime/abstention candidates, nine new candidates total. None replaces causal B1. S3 total false+excess burden 14 vs 6 control. R1 burden unchanged, R2 type 7 vs 8 control. R1/R2 fail four-seed correctness; inherited B1 set iteration can change fault type. Reproducibility is conditional on pinned Python 3.13.16/dependencies and PYTHONHASHSEED=0 at startup, not seed invariance. E3 null comparison failures are separately disclosed and selection not rerun. Fleet-prior E4 not testable with eligible support; not scored. Sources: docs/experiments/RESULTS.md; results/sparse_stuck_followup/FINDINGS.md; results/regime_reference/FINDINGS.md. These are development-informed synthetic results; no general claim against all future methods.

notes.text: Source: results/sensor_ablation/FINDINGS.md, train_group_summary.csv, train_paired_events.csv and manifest.json, reviewed at private Git revision 50eae57. Original 10-event denominator retained in every branch. Correct type is official first matched diagnosis, not an accuracy percentage. Burden is false episodes plus excess repeats over 21 asset-days. Mask removes channel-derived columns and working installed-channel metadata from the beginning; causal reference is recomputed. Vibration/temperature removes two detections but adds one UNKNOWN detection, net -1, and loses two correct first types. PUMP-04-E04 is detected only without this group. Flow/power mask loses PUMP-07 air-entrainment detection but improves calibration-shift first type; this is fixed-detector dependence, not a recommendation to remove instruments. Restores: 9 train + 3 descriptive PUMP-09 checks pass; causal prefix checks 414+138 pass. PUMP-09 is already inspected, descriptive only; not included in the train table. First correct-type delay does not require correct sensor channel and is not the full useful-diagnosis-delay metric.

notes.text: Source: docs/engineering/DECISION_BRIEF.md and SOURCES_AND_UNKNOWNS.md; Task006 measurement-concept contract. This is a functional proposal for an asset missing the stated measurement, not a proposed extra vibration sensor for PUMP-08, which already has vibration and bearing-temperature channels. Select the physical package only after a survey. One measurement point does not cover all bearings. Summary vibration features are not raw waveforms. Wireless is an alternative requiring coverage/battery maintenance, not a guaranteed easier installation. A gateway requires IO/enclosure/power/environment/service decisions. Field buffer/restart/quality behavior has not been implemented or validated by this static replay. The current local engineering UI is implemented; real field integration is proposed. A temporary route or no permanent device remains a valid decision. No purchased equipment, supplier quote, proven installation time, safety certification or diagnostic improvement is implied.

notes.text: Measurement hypothesis: flow, head and input power may support operating-point assessment, but flow alone does not locate an exchanger restriction or prove savings. Costs are an independent illustrative fixture, not a proposed BOM for PUMP-08. Initial 4500 EUR; annual benefit = 0.3 relevant events/year × 0.5 additional actionable fraction × 2000 EUR avoidable repair difference = 300. No production loss assumed because of hypothetical healthy standby. Nuisance =24 checks ×75 EUR=1800; upkeep=700. Annual net=−2200; 5-year value=−4500+5×−2200=−15500. With zero nuisance checks, annual net is still −400 and 5-year value −6500. No simple payback. All parameters are illustrative assumptions. Source: docs/engineering/COST_MODEL_SPEC.md and DECISION_BRIEF.md; PUMP-08 channel absence from assets.csv. Never infer field economic value from synthetic detector recall.

notes.text: Start with one maintenance decision and an accountable owner. Existing signals may be sufficient. Trial a targeted additional measurement with a reference or handheld route; do not induce damaging faults. Review actionable lead time, nuisance workload, outages and integration/service burden against existing practice. Retain a defer/no-install outcome. The proposed field architecture is read-only telemetry and optional sensors to local buffered advisory analysis; it is separate from the current replay prototype. Control, SIS and operational alarms remain independent. Site/class/flag applicability needs engineering review. No certification or customer pilot has occurred. Source: docs/engineering/DECISION_BRIEF.md and SOURCES_AND_UNKNOWNS.md.
